streams.title: New playable characters
streams.summary: Research mapped the available slot structure, and a first Tier A clone-slot prototype was staged. The feature was turned off in the test configuration; the current plan is parked while the character-slot path is validated.
streams.next: Re-run the Tier A test against the corrected build, confirm the character info and save data, then choose the first characters and assets.

streams.title: Costume expansion
streams.summary: Backported and original costumes are part of the project scope. The source notes identify costume wishlists and mappings to decide, but do not yet establish a prioritized public release plan.
streams.next: Choose the first character/outfit pairings and record their source game, slot type, and priority.

streams.title: HD renderer
streams.summary: Phase 1 renderer v20 is built and staged with anisotropic filtering, sharper supersampling, dithering, safer release keys, and quality presets. It has not been installed for in-game validation; renderer testing is paused.
streams.next: Resume testing when safe, install the staged build in the test copy, and run the documented Prologue checks.

streams.title: Redesigned UI
streams.summary: UI scaling and layout fixes have gone through multiple test rounds. The latest recorded update installs v8.18j for a Gallery layout regression; broader UI work is on hold pending in-depth review.
streams.next: Complete the planned hands-on review, report remaining layout issues, and decide whether to resume the next fix round.

streams.title: Larger on-screen battles
streams.summary: The unit-limit effort has mapped key structures and developed relocation prototypes. Separately, renderer notes identify the cost of drawing and shadowing dense crowds; neither track is yet a finished, validated player-facing feature.
streams.next: Finish classifying remaining unit-limit tables, then run controlled test-copy checks and measure crowd performance before raising caps.

streams.title: New and backported stages
streams.summary: New and backported stages are an agreed project goal, but the source notes do not yet define a confirmed shortlist or implementation order.
streams.next: Pick candidate stages, their source games, and the closest WO3U stages to adapt.

streams.title: New enemy types
streams.summary: New enemy types are in the project scope. A wishlist is still needed before the work can be sized or sequenced.
streams.next: List the enemy types to add, their source games, and any notes on how they should behave.

updates.title: UI Gallery layout fix installed
updates.detail: The v8.18j update addresses a Gallery-row regression. The wider UI work remains on hold for a broader review.

updates.title: Renderer Phase 1 staged
updates.detail: The v20 quality-feature build is ready for a future controlled test; no in-game validation is recorded yet.

updates.title: New-slot prototype parked
updates.detail: The Tier A character-slot work was left switched off in the test configuration pending a corrected-build rerun.

updates.title: Crowd performance path outlined
updates.detail: Notes identify shadow reduction and instanced draws as possible ways to lower the cost of larger battles.
